aspect: Fault does not change your workload
description: Being blameless means the other insurer pays. It does not mean fewer calls, fewer appointments or a faster repair.
energy_note: Innocent, and doing all the paperwork.

aspect: Their insurer's job is to pay you less
description: The company assessing your injury is contractually aligned against your interest and is far more practised at this than you are.
A door opens. Broken collarbone, written-off bike, six weeks off. The driver was apologetic; their insurer disputes the value of the bike for four months.
